Game Overview

Mushy is a skill title where guide an adorable mushroom through a whimsically dangerous forest, dodging threats and collecting tasty morsels for points. Experience increasing speeds and test your reflexes in this fast-paced, charming arcade adventure. Perfect your timing, stay vigilant, and strive for high scores amid growing challenges.
